claim: On this bench, TRAP_DELETE of a trap name that does not exist answers -22 ('no resource selected') from a working Tweez 300 GUI, not the -25 the Command Reference implies -- so -22 must count as ready in a readiness probe.
validity_conditions: Measured in the prior project on the microscope PC on 2026-08-27, same session showing the GUI fully live (a create and a delete of a real trap both answered 0). ALSO SEEN HERE: the same probe answered -22 as the first command of the 2026-09-24 session (D:/soft-matter-agents-frames/tweezers-20260924-001/exchanges.jsonl line 2). That is agreement, not a promotion -- no run_id -- so it stays E3. Ruled TRANSFER; slot: the command path. Without -22 counted as ready, a probe calls a healthy GUI dead.
